items.title: ESTABLISH SUPPLY LINE
items.placementTarget: Back of each player reference card
items.text:
ESTABLISH SUPPLY LINE
Spend 2 Supply cubes to draw a straight line from the center of your city to the center of another city.

rules: Draw a straight line from the center of your city to the center of another city.
mechanics.effect: Action: spend 2 Supply cubes to draw a straight supply line from the center of your city to the center of another city. The icon is a yellow dot joined to a red dot.

items.title: Reference card placement
items.text: Place this sticker on the back of each player reference card.

mechanics.effect: Place the Establish Supply Line sticker on the back of each player reference card.

summary: Establish Supply Line action overlay. Spend 2 Supply cubes to draw a straight line from the center of your city to the center of another city. Place it on the back of each player reference card.
